_source: Consolidated Balance Sheet, PDF page 166 of annual-report-2025-2026.pdf (TCS Integrated Annual Report 2025-26).
_unit: INR crore, exactly as printed. No rescaling. Brackets are negative.
_method: Read from the printed statement via `pdftotext -table`, independent of the pipeline's Azure DI OCR. Every subtotal re-derived by hand and ties.
_coverage: FACE LEVEL, deliberately partial. A tag is listed only where its mapping to a printed line is unambiguous. Tags in NEITHER list are out of scope and ignored by score_document -- putting a disclosed-but-unmappable tag in not_reported would score a CORRECT extraction as a false positive.
_notes: Only share capital is unambiguous. Other equity (1,06,878), equity attributable to shareholders (1,07,240), non-controlling interests (1,238) and Total equity (1,08,478) all map to DERIVED tags in v4.3 (TOTOTEQ/TOTEQNR), so the reported values have no extractable home.
